options.description: What to offer, as group name to the choices under it. Groups are listed in the order the object holds them. A choice is what `multiselect()` takes: `disabled` and `selected` mean the same, and a `description` is shown while it is highlighted. A separator is not allowed -- the groups are the headings.
options.name: choices

options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: Whether the cursor wraps from one end of the list to the other. Defaults to `true`; `false` stops it at the first and last row on offer.
options.name: loop

options.description: Refuse more than this many choices. Unlimited if omitted. Groups are not counted.
options.name: max

options.description: Refuse fewer than this many. Defaults to 0, or 1 when `required`.
options.name: min

options.description: Refuse an empty selection. Defaults to `false`. Same as `min: 1`.
options.name: required

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: Whether a group's heading can be ticked. Defaults to `true`. `false` makes a heading a heading: the cursor steps over it and only the choices under it can be ticked.
options.name: selectableGroups

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: An answer to start from: exactly the choices on offer whose `value` is in it start ticked, and every `selected` is ignored -- what `multiselect()` does with one. A value no choice on offer holds is dropped.
options.name: value

registryDescription: A multiselect with its choices under named groups, where a group ticks its children
